business_problem: Beida Yinghua needed to keep a very large legal-information service fast, trustworthy, and secure as its user base and content corpus kept growing. The company wanted stronger search speed, richer multidimensional knowledge features, and stable infrastructure for legal knowledge services, while preserving the domain-quality requirements that make automated legal search and analysis difficult.
solution_summary: Beida Yinghua uses Alibaba Cloud as the infrastructure and search base for its legal-knowledge services. Early cloud adoption covered domain services, monitoring, enterprise email, and cloud hosts, but the more important evolution was on the data side: legal documents, journals, and case data are automatically collected and cleaned, then stored through HBase and a data warehouse so the corpus can keep expanding without degrading search quality. On top of that data foundation, the company introduced Alibaba Cloud Elasticsearch as the engine that supports the search scenarios of Peking University Fabao and related legal-service products. The surrounding legal-tech applications combine large legal knowledge bases, case data, knowledge graphs, and risk-analysis methods into smart law, legislation, and enforcement platforms, giving legal professionals faster access to authoritative materials while retaining human review for the highest-value legal content.

solution_components.name: Elasticsearch
solution_components.role: Provides the search engine that supports Fabao's core legal search scenarios.

solution_components.name: HBase
solution_components.role: Stores large-scale structured legal data and supports high-volume retrieval and expansion of the legal corpus.

solution_components.name: Data warehouse
solution_components.role: Organizes and processes legal information so knowledge features can be mined across documents and cases.

solution_components.name: Cloud hosts
solution_components.role: Run the production services behind Beida Yinghua's legal-information products.

data_flow: Legal documents, journals, case records, and related knowledge artifacts are automatically collected and intelligently cleaned, then written into HBase and the data warehouse. Elasticsearch indexes that corpus for fast legal retrieval, and the results are exposed through Fabao and related smart legal, legislative, and enforcement services that blend search with knowledge-graph and risk-analysis capabilities.
business_outcome: Alibaba Cloud helped Beida Yinghua keep legal search and knowledge services usable at national scale. The company now supports more than 1 million registered individual users and over 30,000 institutional customers, with annual site visits above 120 million and annual active users above 13 million, while expanding more advanced knowledge and legal-intelligence services on top of the same cloud data foundation.
architecture_clues: The legal corpus is not only indexed for search; it is also stored in HBase and organized in a data warehouse for deeper knowledge extraction.
Automated collection and intelligent cleaning are paired with manual legal editorial review for sensitive content quality.
Elasticsearch is used as the production search engine for the company's flagship legal database rather than a sidecar analytics tool.
The same data foundation feeds legal search, legal-management, legislation, and enforcement products.
